# Introduction

To identify systemic immune biomarkers associated with the extent of lung pathology
in untreated (W0) TB patients, we applied Random Forest analysis to screen for
cytokine-stimulus combinations correlated with total cavity volume (CAVTOT) and
total lesion glycolysis (TLG). Candidates were validated using linear and Spearman
correlation models. Biomarkers identified by at least two models are considered
high-confidence associations and reported in Figure 4B.

Figure S11B: Top 50 cytokine-stimulus combinations from Random Forest models
associated with CAVTOT and TLG at W0.

Figure S11C: Linear models identifying cytokines significantly associated with
CAVTOT and TLG across stimulation conditions at W0. Adjusted for Age, Sex, Arm.

Figure S11D: Spearman correlations identifying cytokines significantly associated
with CAVTOT and TLG across stimulation conditions at W0. Adjusted for Age, Sex, Arm.

# Reshape to wide format for Random Forest

```{r}
#| label: reshape-wide

selected_data <- cytokine_pet_data_log %>%
  select(ID1, Visit, Condition, Age, Sex, Arm, CAVTOT, TLG, all_of(cytokine_cols))

selected_data_wide <- selected_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(cytokine_cols),
    names_to  = "Cytokine",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(combined_name = paste(Condition, Cytokine, sep = "_")) %>%
  select(-Condition, -Cytokine) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = combined_name,
    values_from = Value
  )

cat(sprintf("Wide format: %d rows x %d columns\n",
            nrow(selected_data_wide), ncol(selected_data_wide)))
```

# List functions

```{r}
#| label: helper-functions

# Variance filtering within each condition (used for linear and Spearman)
filter_cytokines_by_variance <- function(data, cytokine_cols, conditions, threshold = 0.1) {
  filtered <- list()
  for (condition in conditions) {
    cond_data <- data %>% filter(Condition == condition)
    sds      <- sapply(cytokine_cols, function(cyt) sd(cond_data[[cyt]], na.rm = TRUE))
    passed   <- cytokine_cols[sds > threshold]
    excluded <- cytokine_cols[sds <= threshold]
    if (length(excluded) > 0) {
      message(sprintf("Condition [%s] — excluding low-variance cytokines: %s",
                      condition, paste(excluded, collapse = ", ")))
    }
    filtered[[condition]] <- passed
  }
  filtered
}

# Build complete results grid for heatmap — fills NA for non-significant combos
build_complete_grid <- function(significant_df, conditions) {
  if (nrow(significant_df) == 0) return(NULL)

  all_cytokines <- unique(significant_df$term)
  all_outcomes  <- unique(as.character(significant_df$Outcome))

  expand.grid(
    Outcome   = all_outcomes,
    term      = all_cytokines,
    Condition = conditions
  ) %>%
    left_join(significant_df, by = c("Outcome", "term", "Condition")) %>%
    mutate(
      Condition = factor(Condition, levels = conditions),
      Outcome   = factor(Outcome,   levels = c("CAVTOT", "TLG")),
      significance = ifelse(is.na(significance), "", significance)
    )
}

# Create heatmap (shared by linear, Spearman, and Figure 4B)
create_heatmap <- function(complete_results, title, subtitle, fill_name) {
  ggplot(complete_results, aes(x = Outcome, y = term, fill = estimate)) +
    geom_tile(color = "#999999") +
    geom_text(aes(label = significance), color = "black", size = 4) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low      = "blue",
      mid      = "white",
      high     = "red",
      midpoint = 0,
      na.value = "white",
      name     = fill_name
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ Condition, nrow = 1) +
    labs(
      title    = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x        = "PET outcome",
      y        = "Cytokine (log10, pg/mL)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y      = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title       = element_text(color = "black"),
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.spacing.x  = unit(0.05, "lines"),
      panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "lightgrey", color = "black")
    )
}
```

# Random Forest

```{r}
#| label: rf-function

run_rf_analysis <- function(data, outcome, predictor_cols, save_path = NULL) {

  rf_data <- data %>%
    select(all_of(c(outcome, predictor_cols))) %>%
    drop_na()

  cat(sprintf("\nRF for %s: %d observations | %d predictors\n",
              outcome, nrow(rf_data), length(predictor_cols)))

  # Add 10 random baseline columns
  set.seed(123)
  all_vals  <- unlist(rf_data[, predictor_cols])
  rand_mean <- mean(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  rand_sd   <- sd(all_vals,   na.rm = TRUE)

  for (i in 1:10) {
    rf_data[[paste0("Random_number_", i)]] <- rnorm(nrow(rf_data), rand_mean, rand_sd)
  }

  all_preds  <- c(predictor_cols, paste0("Random_number_", 1:10))
  formula_rf <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ ."))

  # Hyperparameter tuning — 5-fold CV over mtry
  tune_grid     <- expand.grid(mtry = seq(2, floor(sqrt(length(all_preds))), by = 1))
  train_control <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5, verboseIter = FALSE)

  tuned_model <- tryCatch({
    train(
      formula_rf,
      data       = rf_data,
      method     = "rf",
      trControl  = train_control,
      tuneGrid   = tune_grid,
      ntree      = 500,
      importance = TRUE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("RF tuning failed for ", outcome, ": ", e$message)
    NULL
  })

  if (is.null(tuned_model)) return(invisible(NULL))

  best_mtry <- tuned_model$bestTune$mtry
  cat(sprintf("Best mtry: %d\n", best_mtry))

  # Final model with best mtry
  final_model <- randomForest(
    formula_rf,
    data       = rf_data,
    ntree      = 500,
    mtry       = best_mtry,
    importance = TRUE
  )

  # Extract Mean Decrease in Accuracy
  imp_vals       <- importance(final_model, type = 1)[, 1]
  random_rows    <- grep("Random_number_", names(imp_vals), value = TRUE)
  rand_threshold <- mean(imp_vals[random_rows], na.rm = TRUE)

  cat(sprintf("Random baseline threshold: %.4f\n", rand_threshold))

  # Top 50 non-random features
  non_rand_imp <- imp_vals[!grepl("Random_number_", names(imp_vals))]
  sorted_imp   <- sort(non_rand_imp, decreasing = TRUE)
  top50        <- sorted_imp[1:min(50, length(sorted_imp))]

  imp_df <- data.frame(
    Feature         = names(top50),
    Importance      = as.numeric(top50),
    Above_threshold = as.numeric(top50) > rand_threshold
  ) %>%
    mutate(Feature = factor(Feature, levels = rev(names(top50))))

  p <- ggplot(imp_df, aes(x = Importance, y = Feature, color = Above_threshold)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 0, xend = Importance, y = Feature, yend = Feature),
    color    = "grey85",
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = rand_threshold,
    linetype   = "dashed",
    color      = "gray40",
    linewidth  = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "gray60", "TRUE" = "darkred"),
    labels = c("FALSE" = "Below threshold", "TRUE" = "Above threshold"),
    name   = "Importance"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    title    = sprintf("Random Forest variable importance for %s", outcome),
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Top %d features | Red = above random baseline (%.3f) | Best mtry = %d",
      nrow(imp_df), rand_threshold, best_mtry
    ),
    x        = "Mean Decrease in Accuracy",
    y        = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),     # remove default gridlines — dotted segments replace them
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text        = element_text(color = "black", size = 8),
    axis.title       = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.position  = "bottom"
  )

  print(p)

  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(save_path,
                           sprintf("Figure_S11B_RF_%s_importance.pdf", outcome)),
      plot  = p,
      width = 6,
      height = 9
    )
    write_xlsx(
      imp_df,
      path = file.path(save_path,
                       sprintf("Figure_S11B_RF_%s_importance.xlsx", outcome))
    )
  }

  invisible(list(model = final_model, importance = imp_df, threshold = rand_threshold))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: run-rf
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 12
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Get all Condition_Cytokine predictor columns from wide format
combined_cols <- names(selected_data_wide)[
  !names(selected_data_wide) %in% c("ID1", "Visit", "Age", "Sex", "Arm", "CAVTOT", "TLG")
]

# Variance filtering across all combined predictors
combined_sds   <- sapply(combined_cols, function(col) sd(selected_data_wide[[col]], na.rm = TRUE))
valid_combined <- combined_cols[combined_sds > variance_threshold]

cat(sprintf("Combined predictors after variance filtering: %d / %d\n",
            length(valid_combined), length(combined_cols)))

# Run RF for both outcomes
rf_results <- list()

for (out in outcomes) {
  rf_results[[out]] <- run_rf_analysis(
    data           = selected_data_wide,
    outcome        = out,
    predictor_cols = valid_combined,
    save_path      = output_main
  )
}
```

# Linear correlation

```{r}
#| label: linear-variance-filter
#| message: true

filtered_cytokines <- filter_cytokines_by_variance(
  data          = cytokine_pet_data_log,
  cytokine_cols = cytokine_cols,
  conditions    = conditions,
  threshold     = variance_threshold
)
```

```{r}
#| label: run-linear
#| message: true
#| warning: false

linear_results <- list()

for (condition in conditions) {

  condition_data  <- cytokine_pet_data_log %>%
    filter(Condition == condition) %>%
    drop_na(Age, Sex, Arm)              

  valid_cytokines <- filtered_cytokines[[condition]]

  if (length(valid_cytokines) == 0) {
    message(sprintf("Condition [%s] — no cytokines pass variance filter; skipping.", condition))
    next
  }

  valid_outcomes <- outcomes[sapply(outcomes, function(out) {
    n_distinct(condition_data[[out]], na.rm = TRUE) >= 2
  })]

  if (length(valid_outcomes) == 0) next

  condition_data <- condition_data %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(valid_outcomes),  ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)))) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(valid_cytokines), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))))

  for (outcome in valid_outcomes) {
    for (cytokine in valid_cytokines) {

      # Includes covariates
      formula <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", cytokine, "+ Age + Sex + Arm"))

      tryCatch({
        model      <- lm(formula, data = condition_data)
        tidy_model <- broom::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
          filter(term == cytokine) %>%   
          mutate(Outcome = outcome, Condition = condition)

        linear_results[[paste(condition, outcome, cytokine, sep = "_")]] <- tidy_model

      }, error = function(e) {
        message(sprintf("Linear error — %s | %s | %s: %s",
                        condition, outcome, cytokine, e$message))
      })
    }
  }
}

linear_results_df <- bind_rows(linear_results) %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  mutate(p.adjusted = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup()

cat(sprintf("Total linear model terms: %d\n", nrow(linear_results_df)))

write_xlsx(
  linear_results_df,
  path = file.path(output_main, "Figure_S11C_linear_all_results.xlsx")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-linear
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

significant_linear <- linear_results_df %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ ""
    ),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = conditions),
    Outcome   = factor(Outcome,   levels = c("CAVTOT", "TLG"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Condition, Outcome, term)

cat(sprintf("Significant linear associations: %d\n",
            nrow(significant_linear)))

write_xlsx(
  significant_linear,
  path = file.path(output_main, "Figure_S11C_linear_significant.xlsx")
)

complete_linear <- build_complete_grid(significant_linear, conditions)

if (!is.null(complete_linear) && nrow(complete_linear) > 0) {

  linear_heatmap <- create_heatmap(
    complete_results = complete_linear,
    title     = "Linear correlations of W0 cytokines with W0 PET outcomes",
    subtitle  = "p value: * < 0.05  ** < 0.01  *** < 0.001",
    fill_name = "Standardized\nEffect Size"
  )

  print(linear_heatmap)

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_main, "Figure_S11C_linear_heatmap.pdf"),
    plot     = linear_heatmap,
    width    = 7,
    height   = 9
  )

} else {
  cat("No significant linear associations at nominal p < 0.05.\n")
}
```

# Spearman correlation

```{r}
#| label: run-spearman
#| message: true
#| warning: false

spearman_results <- list()

for (condition in conditions) {

  condition_data  <- cytokine_pet_data_log %>%
    filter(Condition == condition) %>%
    drop_na(Age, Sex, Arm)              

  valid_cytokines <- filtered_cytokines[[condition]]

  if (length(valid_cytokines) == 0) {
    message(sprintf("Condition [%s] — no cytokines pass variance filter; skipping.", condition))
    next
  }

  valid_outcomes <- outcomes[sapply(outcomes, function(out) {
    n_distinct(condition_data[[out]], na.rm = TRUE) >= 2
  })]

  if (length(valid_outcomes) == 0) next

  for (outcome in valid_outcomes) {

    fit_out   <- lm(as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ Age + Sex + Arm")),
                    data = condition_data)
    resid_out <- residuals(fit_out)

    for (cytokine in valid_cytokines) {

      fit_cyt   <- lm(as.formula(paste(cytokine, "~ Age + Sex + Arm")),
                      data = condition_data)
      resid_cyt <- residuals(fit_cyt)

      tryCatch({
        cor_test <- cor.test(
          resid_cyt,
          resid_out,
          method = "spearman",
          exact  = FALSE
        )

        spearman_results[[paste(condition, outcome, cytokine, sep = "_")]] <- data.frame(
          term      = cytokine,
          estimate  = cor_test$estimate,
          p.value   = cor_test$p.value,
          conf.low  = NA_real_,
          conf.high = NA_real_,
          Outcome   = outcome,
          Condition = condition
        )

      }, error = function(e) {
        message(sprintf("Spearman error — %s | %s | %s: %s",
                        condition, outcome, cytokine, e$message))
      })
    }
  }
}

spearman_results_df <- bind_rows(spearman_results) %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  mutate(p.adjusted = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup()

cat(sprintf("Total Spearman tests: %d\n", nrow(spearman_results_df)))

write_xlsx(
  spearman_results_df,
  path = file.path(output_main, "Figure_S11D_spearman_all_results.xlsx")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-spearman
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

  filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ ""
    ),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = conditions),
    Outcome   = factor(Outcome,   levels = c("CAVTOT", "TLG"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Condition, Outcome, term)

cat(sprintf("Significant Spearman associations (nominal p < 0.05): %d\n",
            nrow(significant_spearman)))

write_xlsx(
  significant_spearman,
  path = file.path(output_main, "Figure_S11D_spearman_significant.xlsx")
)

complete_spearman <- build_complete_grid(significant_spearman, conditions)

if (!is.null(complete_spearman) && nrow(complete_spearman) > 0) {

  spearman_heatmap <- create_heatmap(
    complete_results = complete_spearman,
    title     = "Spearman correlations of W0 cytokines with W0 PET outcomes",
    subtitle  = "p value: * < 0.05  ** < 0.01  *** < 0.001",
    fill_name = "Spearman's rho"
  )

  print(spearman_heatmap)

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_main, "Figure_S11D_spearman_heatmap.pdf"),
    plot     = spearman_heatmap,
    width    = 7,
    height   = 9
  )

} else {
  cat("No significant Spearman associations at nominal p < 0.05.\n")
}
```

# High-confidence biomarkers (significant in both models)

```{r}
#| label: figure-4b
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8

make_id <- function(df) paste(df$Condition, df$Outcome, df$term, sep = "_")

linear_ids   <- make_id(significant_linear)
spearman_ids <- make_id(significant_spearman)
hc_ids       <- intersect(linear_ids, spearman_ids)

cat(sprintf(
  "Biomarkers significant in both models: %d  (linear: %d | Spearman: %d)\n",
  length(hc_ids), length(linear_ids), length(spearman_ids)
))

if (length(hc_ids) > 0) {

  high_confidence <- significant_linear %>%
    filter(make_id(.) %in% hc_ids)

  complete_hc <- build_complete_grid(high_confidence, conditions)

  hc_heatmap <- create_heatmap(
    complete_results = complete_hc,
    title     = "High-confidence cytokine biomarkers at W0",
    subtitle  = "Significant in both linear and Spearman models (p value: * < 0.05  ** < 0.01  *** < 0.001)",
    fill_name = "Standardized\nEffect Size"
  )

  print(hc_heatmap)

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_main, "High_confidence_heatmap_LM_Spearman.pdf"),
    plot     = hc_heatmap,
    width    = 7,
    height   = 9
  )

  write_xlsx(
    high_confidence,
    path = file.path(output_main, "High_confidence_biomarkers_LM_Spearman.xlsx")
  )

} else {
  cat("No high-confidence biomarkers found. Consider reviewing the p-value threshold.\n")
}

cat("\nAll outputs saved to:", output_main, "\n")
```
